mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within 6 months of signal, or 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where UNRATE drops below 5%, or core PCE inflation fails to exceed 2.5% within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth is negative, or the ISM manufacturing PMI remains above 50 for 3 months after the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%, or the 10-year Treasury yield fails to exceed the fed funds rate within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year and consumer sentiment is above its 12-month average, it signals a strengthening consumer sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST y/y growth > 10% and RSAFS > 12m avg
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the interaction condition is met, or the consumer discretionary sector underperforms the S&P 500 over the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5% and payroll employment growth accelerates by more than 200,000 jobs per month, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the interaction condition is met, or average hourly earnings growth fails to exceed 3% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflation scare that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the interaction condition is met, or the 5-year breakeven inflation rate fails to rise above 2.5% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates by more than 3% quarter-over-quarter and the ISM manufacturing PMI is above 55, it signals a strengthening industrial sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the interaction condition is met, or the industrial sector underperforms the S&P 500 over the next 3 months.
